text:
- Hugo: Out rest of week; Dell covering. Wants east wing kept clear for visitors.
- Zelworth fleet mileage cap: 7,500.
- Dell: Swapping desks with Pia; covering Cora and Hugo. Wants north office kept clear for visitors.
- Garden studio: Repainting (evening noise); coffee machine working. Rafe prefers this for reviews. Afternoon stand-up moved here.
- Library annex: Too cold in morning; repainting (afternoon noise); Suri wants kept clear for visitors.
- North office: Repainting (morning noise); coffee machine working. Lift near it is slow.
- East wing: Repainting (morning noise); slow lift; coffee machine working. Nils thinks it is too cold in the morning.
- Lifts near library annex, print room, loading bay: Slow.
- Afternoon stand-up: Moved to garden studio.
- Print room: Coffee machine working.
- User needs to send Kira, Una, Finn, Hugo, Dell, Nils, Opal, Esme notes from respective meetings.
- Teo: Swapping desks with Ada; covering Wren.
